ESD Industries Inc.">Baltimore Aircoil of Canada Inc. v. ESD Industries Inc. (2002), 60 O.R. (3d) 290, 2002 CarswellOnt 2286, 25 C.L.R. (3d) 227 (S.C.J.)</ref></cite>—Whether an individual defendant was in breach of trust or whether the corporate defendant was in breach of its trust, and the individual defendant was statutorily liable for the corporate breach of trust by operation of the Act, was irrelevant to their joint and several liability. It is not essential for the imposition of joint and several liability under s. 13(3) that the defendants all be trustees as such. Joint and several liability arises as a consequence of the straightforward operation of the subsection. Put in simple terms, the legislature's declaration that such persons are jointly and severally liable ends the matter.</para.text></para></editorial.commentary.section.body></editorial.commentary.section>
